checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate assets delivered (4:5 poster, 9:16 story, 9:16 reel)
must.why: Poster is 512x640 (4:5), story and reel are vertical.

must.item: Warm lantern imagery and coordinated midnight-blue and gold design
must.why: All use lanterns, navy panel and gold/cream text (the reel only in its first frame).

must.item: Each asset includes the exact event text
must.why: Date, time, venue and free-entry lines are garbled in both images and in the reel's first frame. Text is absent from the reel after 1 s.

must.item: Reel runs 10 s with visible motion
must.why: Lantern scenes shift slightly across frames, but the text panel disappears after the first second, so the 'panel stays still' brief is not met.

must.item: Text legible and unclipped in both images; reel holds details long enough to read
must.why: The title is legible, but the other lines are garbled. The reel shows no text at 4, 7 and 9.5 s.

exact_text.read_as: Free entry, overlapped by the line above and cut at the top

faults.what: The date, time, venue and free-entry lines are garbled in the poster and story, with overlapping and warped letters. The venue line is unreadable.
The reel shows text only at about 1 s. It is gone by 4 s, 7 s and 9.5 s, so the details are never held. The brief asked for the panel to stay still.
The text on the first reel frame is garbled in the same way.
The assistant's message implied the text had been checked, but the output shows it was not.
The poster background is pixelated and blocky at the sides, and the panel covers most of the scene.
The small lines are tiny and low in contrast compared with the title.

summary: The pack has a coherent lantern, navy and gold look and a moving reel, but the date, time, venue and free-entry text is garbled on the poster and story, and the reel loses its text after the first second.
